newsitem.title: USA: Trans Leasing names permanent CEO.
newsitem.headline: Trans Leasing names permanent CEO.

text.p: Trans Leasing International Inc said on Friday it has named Larry Grossman as permanent chief executive officer.
Trans Leasing said it also appointed Michael Heyman as president and chief operating officer.

On October 14, the company said Grossman was elected chairman of the board and interim chief executive. He is a founder of the company, served as chief executive through 1982 and has been a director since 1991.
Heyman has also been a director since 1991. The position of chief operating officer was newly created.
Former chairman, chief executive and president Richard Grossman, 44, died on October 7.
